items.title: Surprise as ASX surges past inflation shock
items.summary: Australia’s major banks and real estate stocks have powered the ASX 200 higher, defying hotter-than-expected inflation data and looming RBA rate hike fears.

items.title: Wall Street Is Done Giving AI Software a Pass
items.summary: Fortinet and ServiceNow plunged 22% and 27%, respectively, as investors punished soft guidance and questioned whether AI hype can deliver real growth.

items.title: ‘Tough environment’: Major retail sales cool
items.summary: Three of Australia’s most powerful retailers have simultaneously flagged slowing sales as cost-of-living pressures bite hard.

aus.headline: ASX Shrugs Off Hot Inflation
aus.body: Banks and property shares lifted the ASX 200 despite hotter-than-expected inflation.
aus.why: Hot inflation data keeps RBA rate hike fears in play.

us.headline: AI Software Stocks Sink
us.body: ServiceNow fell 27% and Fortinet 22% as investors punished soft guidance.
us.why: Investors are now doubting AI hype turns into real growth.

biz.headline: Big Retailers Feel Pinch
biz.body: Three major Aussie retailers have all flagged slowing sales at the same time.
biz.why: Cost-of-living pressure is showing up at the checkout.
